summary: Unicycive Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on September 3, 2026 a securities class action was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California against the company and certain officers. The suit alleges federal securities law violations tied to public statements about the oxylanthanum carbonate new drug application for hyperphosphatemia in dialysis-dependent chronic kidney disease patients. No monetary terms, settlement framework, board recommendation, or advisor are stated. Management deems the claims meritless and intends to defend vigorously; no structural or deal mechanics apply. Watch litigation milestones and any disclosure-driven volatility.
